title: Gotha (Japan, v1.000): built-in instruction edits
summary: Move the two built-in Gotha edits to one guarded disc sector.
rationale: Both unconditional menu writes target bytes in the exact first-read program. The recipe preserves those bytes and their order without editing the original image; the upstream callback does not document the underlying game failure.
